text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (—Waking up in the morning. Gazing at the sky.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(And I imagine the sky beyond,
connected to this very sky.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (――The sky floating above that dreamlike place.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even so,
it's probably still the middle of the night over there... Hehe♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: By the way, the sky over here is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —The cherry blossoms are dancing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Truly spring.
A sky perfectly suited for a fresh beginning...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today begins the journey of taking on the
Twinkle Series with my trainee, Sakura Laurel.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting.
We're all good to go!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
Come, let's go♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, on the first day of training,
the first place the two of us headed to was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It was a hospital.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I will give you the examination results.
Are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes. Please explain the condition of my body to my Trainer as well.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: "...Understood. As a premise, an Umamusume's body undergoes growth stages unique to Umamusume. The prime example of this is the 'Bloom Period.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Awakening.
It is a growth phase unique to Umamusume
in which their racing capabilities rapidly develop.
choice_data_list: Laurel has entered her growth spurt too, right?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As a result of the examination, those signs
were indeed confirmed. However—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—"The development of her organs, particularly in her legs,
is lagging behind that of other Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Right, Doctor? My legs are still fragile.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"...That is correct. Please think of them
as "glass legs" that could break at any moment."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: In Laurel-san's case, even a training volume or load that would be fine for other girls could lead to a serious injury.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"...Please take every precaution
when you have her make her debut."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "...The hospital doctor gave us a stern warning, didn't they?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if she had already anticipated it,
the doctor's words must have been
a painful diagnosis for Sakura Laurel.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To put it bluntly, compared to the other girls, my body won't even let me put in the effort needed to win...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Dadadadadada!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Brian-chan and Hishi Ama-chan...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On the track were two Umamusume debuting this year
just like Sakura Laurel:
Narita Brian and Hishi Amazon."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Both of them ran so amazingly.
Their sheer momentum completely stole my attention...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I can't take my eyes off Brian-chan in particular!
Staying so low to the ground and then accelerating with such force...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's like she's just running on pure instinct,
running because she just wants to run so badly—!
choice_data_list: (To run following my own instincts, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is running that Sakura Laurel cannot afford right now.
If she pushes with all her might, her legs will...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Don't look so sad, now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Please stop apologizing, too.
More importantly...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right!
I'll go run a lap!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And Sakura Laurel dashed forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's not the pace set by Narita Brian and the others...
It's Sakura Laurel's run.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Phew... For an initial training session,
I believe I was able to put out a decent amount of speed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer!
Try to recall veeery carefully what the teacher said.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I may have this kind of body, but no one ever told me 'don't make your debut.'

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: No one told me not to train! And no one told me not to enter races either!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even with these legs, I can debut!
I have a future! I have the right to dream ahead!
That is an undeniable—fact!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: So Trainer, with me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Drip... drop...
Pitter... patter...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Rain?
choice_data_list: Get under a roof before you get chilled!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Thanks to you,
I managed not to get very wet.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It looked like it was about to start pouring down, after all.
Look, just check out the sky right now...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...It really is.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Heh, hehehe!
I never imagined I'd go out this quickly.
Ahaha!
choice_data_list: Sorry! For rushing you like that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
No, I was panicking just as much as you back then.
Fufu, more importantly!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, come here.
Look, out the window!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —Look, there's a rainbow.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
『Après la pluie,
　　le beau temps !』

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It is a French proverb.
It means: "After the rain comes fair weather."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. The path we walk from here on
won't always be clear skies.
There will surely be times we're caught in sudden downpours.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“Still, we got a rainbow precisely because it rained!
And we got to see such a wonderful view together!”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: So please believe in us. Someday, we too will reach beyond that rainbow, where the dreams of the whole world gather...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"You can even aim for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!
For the dream of being the best in the world!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...And another thing, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I haven't given up on the Japanese Derby,
or the Triple Crown for that matter.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho—
Since I'm debuting, I definitely want to challenge the Classic Triple Crown, too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Won't you make our dreams come true one by one with me... and grow together as a pair?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, my days alongside Sakura Laurel began—an Umamusume who, despite facing adversity, brightly dreamed of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
